title: ComfyUI Subgraph user guide
use_for: Subgraphs as reusable workflow components; creation from selected nodes; exposed input/output slots; bypass behavior; nested subgraphs; subgraph blueprints.
notes: Official docs describe subgraphs as reusable nodes for simplifying complex workflows and state slot connections follow normal datatype validation.

title: ComfyUI Subgraph blueprints developer documentation
use_for: Packaging reusable subgraph components in custom node directories under a subgraphs folder.
notes: Official docs state ComfyUI scans custom node directories for subgraph files and serves them through /global_subgraphs.

title: ComfyUI UI subgraphs developer guide
use_for: Nested subgraph identifiers, recursive traversal, root graph vs active graph, subgraph events, and widget promotion.
notes: Use for frontend extension behavior; node IDs inside subgraphs require careful treatment.

title: ComfyUI Nodes core concepts
use_for: General node graph model, node states, missing/error states, and datatype-valid connections.
notes: Official docs define nodes as independent functional modules connected by links with datatype validation.

title: ComfyUI Workflow JSON schema
use_for: Workflow graph serialization, nodes, links, groups, config, and schema-bound structure.
notes: Use for workflow-as-data reasoning and link/source-of-truth rules.

title: ComfyUI ComfySwitchNode built-in docs
use_for: Boolean switch logic using MATCH_TYPE inputs for routing one of two typed values.
notes: The docs say the Switch node outputs on_true or on_false based on a boolean switch.

title: ComfyUI ComfySoftSwitchNode built-in docs
use_for: Lazy switch behavior and typed routing where only the needed input is evaluated.
notes: The docs say Soft Switch is lazy and requires the true/false inputs to share the same data type.

title: ComfyUI Lazy Evaluation documentation
use_for: Switch/router nodes, skipping expensive unused branches, ExecutionBlocker behavior, and output disabling patterns.
notes: Official docs state lazy evaluation is useful for switch nodes and explain check_lazy_status plus ExecutionBlocker.

title: ComfyUI Node Expansion documentation
use_for: Programmatic graph expansion, GraphBuilder, loop-like nodes, and cache-aware subgraph construction.
notes: Use for advanced developer workflows where a node expands into a graph at execution time.

title: ComfyUI Node Replacement documentation
use_for: Migrating deprecated nodes, renamed nodes, refactored inputs, output mapping, and widget binding.
notes: Use when recommending stable workflow packaging and migration-safe custom node evolution.

title: ComfyUI Workflow templates documentation
use_for: Packaging example workflows for custom nodes and exposing them through the template browser.
notes: Use for one-click learning examples and node-pack release packaging.
